title: The text discusses various developments in East Africa, focusing on the signing of a significant contract for digital satellite technology in Kenya, the activities of former Ugandan President Milton Obote in Zambia, and the expansion of International Correspondence Schools in Tanzania. E E Teete, a key figure in the Kenyan contract, emphasizes the importance of hard work and interpersonal skills in business dealings. The text also touches on the challenges faced by coffee producers due to falling prices and the unpredictable nature of gold prices in the market, highlighting the complexities of international trade and economic conditions.
